description: SIM95 — RIFT CMB Polarization EE/TE (CLASS full Boltzmann). Extends SIM88 (TT) to E-mode polarization. Runs CLASS with output=tCl,pCl,lCl for three cosmologies: RIFT BAO-only best-fit (SIM87), RIFT/LCDM joint best-fit (SIM90), and LCDM Planck best-fit. Compares against Planck 2018 best-fit theory spectrum. Tests: (1) RMS(DC_l/C_l) for EE and TE, (2) Approximate Planck polarization likelihood, (3) Consistency check: joint best-fit should match Planck EE/TE at same level as TT.

rift_bao_only.note: RIFT BAO-only best-fit (SIM87). Shows BAO-CMB tension in polarization.

rift_joint.note: RIFT joint CMB+BAO best-fit (SIM90). Should match Planck EE/TE.

likelihood.note: Approximate Gaussian likelihood. EE and TE using same f_sky as TT (Planck plikHM).

noise.note: Planck 143 GHz. T noise from SIM89. P noise = sqrt(2) * Delta_T (polarization noise is sqrt(2) larger for Stokes Q/U).

acceptance.note: Joint best-fit should satisfy RMS < 15% for EE and TE (same threshold as TT in SIM88: 2.93% << 10%). BAO-only best-fit tension is expected to be large, analogous to SIM89.
